description: Deploy static build output (dist / build / any folder) to any SSH-reachable server: tar, scp, then atomic directory swap on the remote host, with automatic backup of the previous release, backup rotation, ownership fixup and a post-deploy hook. Nothing is hardcoded — server, port, path, key are all parameters. ｜ 通用前端/静态构建产物远程部署，支持任意服务器地址与端口、旧版本备份与回滚。
